          echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "### Artifacts" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY

          echo "- Build log: \`expo/expo-build.log\`" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY

# IVX Android Emulator QA — GitHub Actions Ubuntu Runner
#
# Uses `npx expo run:android` which handles ALL the complexity:
#   - Expo prebuild (generates native Android project)
#   - Gradle build
#   - Boots an Android emulator
#   - Installs the APK
#   - Launches the app
#
# Then we capture screenshots and run Maestro flows.
#
# Triggers:
#   - Push to main (when chat files, Maestro flows, or this workflow change)
#   - Manual dispatch via GitHub Actions UI
#
# Secrets required (already configured in repo):
#   - EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
#   - EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY

name: Android Emulator QA

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'expo/app/ivx/chat.tsx'
      - 'expo/src/modules/chat/**'
      - 'expo/.maestro/**'
      - 'expo/eas.json'
      - 'expo/app.config.ts'
      - 'expo/package.json'
      - '.github/workflows/android-emulator-qa.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      run_full_qa:
        description: 'Run full chat QA (requires OWNER_PASSWORD secret)'
        required: false
        default: false
        type: boolean

env:
  EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL: https://api.ivxholding.com
  EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL }}
  EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY: ${{ secrets.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY }}
  EXPO_PUBLIC_QA_BUILD: 'true'
  OWNER_EMAIL: iperez4242@gmail.com

permissions:
  contents: read
  issues: write

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    name: Android Emulator Build + QA
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    outputs:
      build_status: ${{ steps.build.outcome }}
      apk_path: ${{ steps.apk.outputs.path }}
      emulator_name: ${{ steps.emu.outputs.name }}
      android_version: ${{ steps.emu.outputs.version }}
      maestro_launch_result: ${{ steps.maestro-launch.outcome }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Setup Java 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Install dependencies
        working-directory: expo
        run: |
          npm install --legacy-peer-deps

      - name: Verify Expo CLI
        working-directory: expo
        run: |
          echo "=== Node version ==="
          node --version
          echo "=== Expo CLI version ==="
          npx expo --version
          echo "=== Expo package version ==="
          node -e "console.log('expo:', require('expo/package.json').version)"

      - name: Expo prebuild (generate native Android project)
        working-directory: expo
        run: |
          npx expo prebuild --platform android --clean --no-install
        env:
          EXPO_PUBLIC_SOURCE_COMMIT_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}

      - name: Build Android APK
        id: build
        working-directory: expo/android
        continue-on-error: true
        timeout-minutes: 30
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          echo "=== Building APK with Gradle ==="
          chmod +x gradlew
          ./gradlew assembleDebug 2>&1 | tee gradle-build.log
          GRADLE_EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
          echo "=== Gradle exit code: $GRADLE_EXIT ==="
          echo "build_exit=$GRADLE_EXIT" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          if [ "$GRADLE_EXIT" -eq 0 ]; then
            echo "build_status=success" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "build_status=failed" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "=== BUILD FAILED — last 200 lines ==="
            tail -200 gradle-build.log
            echo "### Build Failure — Last 200 Lines" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
            echo '```' >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
            tail -200 gradle-build.log >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
            echo '```' >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          fi

      - name: Check build result
        working-directory: expo/android
        if: steps.build.outputs.build_status != 'success'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          echo "::error::Gradle build failed. Creating diagnostic issue."
          {
            echo "## Android Emulator QA Build Diagnostics"
            echo ""
            echo "**Commit:** ${GITHUB_SHA}"
            echo "**Run:** ${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"
            echo ""
            echo "### Gradle build output (last 400 lines)"
            echo '```'
            tail -400 gradle-build.log 2>/dev/null || echo "not found"
            echo '```'
          } > diagnostic-body.md
          gh label create "android-qa-diagnostic" --color "FBCA04" 2>/dev/null || true
          gh issue create \
            --title "Android QA Build Diagnostics — ${GITHUB_SHA:0:12}" \
            --body-file diagnostic-body.md \
            --label "android-qa-diagnostic" 2>&1 || \
          gh issue create --title "Android QA Build Diagnostics — ${GITHUB_SHA:0:12}" --body-file diagnostic-body.md 2>&1 || true
          exit 1

      - name: Find built APK
        id: apk
        working-directory: expo/android
        run: |
          echo "=== Searching for APK ==="
          APK_PATH=$(find . -name "*.apk" -type f 2>/dev/null | head -1)
          if [ -z "$APK_PATH" ]; then
            echo "::error::No APK found"
            find . -name "*.apk" 2>/dev/null
            exit 1
          fi
          APK_PATH_ABS="$(cd "$(dirname "$APK_PATH")" && pwd)/$(basename "$APK_PATH")"
          echo "path=$APK_PATH_ABS" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "APK found: $APK_PATH_ABS"
          ls -lh "$APK_PATH_ABS"

      # ============================================================
      # Boot Android Emulator using reactivecircus/android-emulator-runner
      # ============================================================
      - name: Boot Android Emulator
        id: emu
        uses: reactivecircus/android-emulator-runner@v2
        with:
          api-level: 34
          arch: x86_64
          profile: pixel_7
          target: google_apis
          disable-animations: true
          emulator-options: -no-window -gpu swiftshader_indirect -no-snapshot -noaudio -no-boot-anim
          script: |
            echo "Emulator booted"
            adb devices
            # Get emulator info
            EMU_NAME=$(adb shell getprop ro.product.model)
            ANDROID_VER=$(adb shell getprop ro.build.version.release)
            echo "name=$EMU_NAME" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "version=$ANDROID_VER" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "Emulator: $EMU_NAME (Android $ANDROID_VER)"

      - name: Install APK on emulator
        run: |
          adb install -r "${{ steps.apk.outputs.path }}"
          echo "APK installed"

      - name: Launch app and capture screenshot
        run: |
          adb shell am start -n com.ivxholdings.app/.MainActivity
          sleep 10
          adb exec-out screencap -p > screenshot-01-launch.png
          echo "Launch screenshot saved"

      - name: Capture logcat
        run: |
          adb logcat -d -t 500 > logcat.txt 2>&1 || true

      - name: Install Maestro
        run: |
          curl -Ls "https://get.maestro.mobile.dev" | bash
          echo "$HOME/.maestro/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
          maestro --version

      - name: Run Maestro launch test
        id: maestro-launch
        working-directory: expo
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          # Android Maestro flow (use the same launch test, Maestro supports Android)
          maestro test .maestro/ivx-app-launch.yaml --format junit --output maestro-launch-results.xml 2>&1 | tee maestro-launch.log
          echo "Maestro launch test completed"

      - name: Take post-test screenshot
        run: |
          adb exec-out screencap -p > screenshot-02-post-test.png || true

      - name: Upload all artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: android-emulator-qa-${{ github.sha }}
          path: |
            screenshot-*.png
            logcat.txt
            expo/android/gradle-build.log
            expo/maestro-launch-results.xml
            expo/maestro-launch.log
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Generate QA summary
        if: always()
        run: |
          echo "## Android Emulator QA Results" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "| Item | Value |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "| --- | --- |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "| Commit SHA | \`${{ github.sha }}\` |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "| Emulator | ${{ steps.emu.outputs.name }} |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "| Android Version | ${{ steps.emu.outputs.version }} |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "| Build Status | \`${{ steps.build.outcome }}\` |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "| Maestro Launch | \`${{ steps.maestro-launch.outcome }}\` |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "### Artifacts" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- Screenshots: \`screenshot-01-launch.png\`, \`screenshot-02-post-test.png\`" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- Logcat: \`logcat.txt\`" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- Maestro results: \`maestro-launch-results.xml\`" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY

## FMT_STRING consteval error with Apple clang 21 (Xcode ...
https://github.com/fmtlib/fmt/issues/4740

Compiling the `fmt` pod via CocoaPods on Xcode 26.4 (Apple clang 21.0.0, `clang-2100.0.123.102`) fails with:
...
```
error: call to consteval function 'fmt::basic_format_string<char, ...>::basic_format_string<FMT_COMPILE_STRING, 0>' is not a constant expression
```
...
Errors appear in `fmt/include/fmt/format-inl.h` at lines 59, 60, 1387, 1391, and 1394 — all call sites of `FMT_STRING(...)`.
...
.0.
...
- fmt version: bundled with `@maplibre/maplibre-react-native`
...
`base.h` sets `FMT_USE_CONSTEVAL 1` for Apple clang ≥ 14 (`__apple_build_version__ >= 14000029L`), enabling the consteval constructor in `basic_format_string`. Apple clang 21 is stricter about requiring consteval call sites to themselves be constant expressions, so the `FMT_STRING(...)` usages in `format-inl.h` — which are not constant expressions — are rejected.
...
Patch `base.h` to treat all Apple clang versions the same as `< 14` (i.e. `FMT_USE_CONSTEVAL 0`):
...
```diff
-#elif defined(__apple_build_version__) && __apple_build_version__ < 14000029L
+#elif defined(__apple_build_version__)
 #  define FMT_USE_CONSTEVAL 0  // consteval is broken in Apple clang
```
...
Note: passing `-DFMT_CONSTEVAL=` or `-DFMT_USE_CONSTEVAL=0` via compiler flags does **not** work, because `base.h` unconditionally redefines both macros through its own `#if/#elif` chain, overwriting any `-D` flag.
...
> > Note: passing -DFMT_CONSTEVAL= or -DFMT_USE_CONSTEVAL=0 via compiler flags does not work, because base.h unconditionally redefines both macros through its own #if/#elif chain, overwriting any -D flag.
> 
> This is incorrect. User-provided `FMT_USE_CONSTEVAL` is checked first and takes precedence over any auto-detection:
> 
> https://github.com/fmtlib/fmt/blob/9396f77fe4b007d4803ff2248a0926f2ced46951/include/fmt/base.h#L117-L118
> 
> The root cause is also not quite correct because `FMT_STRING("...")` is a constant expression.
...
> Thanks for the clarification. After investigating further:
> 
> **The fmt version in question is 11.0.2**, bundled via React Native's `RCT-Folly` CocoaPod (which pins `fmt = 11.0.2`). In that version, `FMT_USE_CONSTEVAL` is not guarded by `#ifdef`, so user-provided values via `-D` flags are overwritten by the detection chain — which is why the preprocessor flag approach didn't work for us. The `#ifdef` guard was added in **12.1.0**, per [the 12.1.0 release notes](https://github.com/fmtlib/fmt/releases/tag/12.1.0).
> 
> So the fix already exists in fmt 12.1.0 — the issue is that React Native hasn't upgraded yet. This is being tracked in:
...
> - [facebook/react-native#55601](https://github.com/facebook/react-native/issues/55601) — original issue report
> - [facebook/react-native#56225](https://github.com/facebook/react-native/issues/56225) — open PR to backport the fmt 12.1.0 bump
> 
> Apologies for the incorrect root cause analysis in the original report. Feel free to close this issue — the fix is in fmt and the ball is in React Native's court.

error: call to consteval function 'fmt::basic_format_string<char, ...>::basic_format_string<FMT_COMPILE_STRING, 0>' is not a constant expression
CommandError: Failed to build iOS project. "xcodebuild" exited with error code 65.
```

This is a **known Xcode 26 / Apple Clang 21 compatibility issue** with `fmt 11.0.2` bundled in React Native's RCT-Folly. I researched the official fix from the React Native community ([facebook/react-native#55601](https://github.com/facebook/react-native/issues/55601)) and created an Expo config plugin:
- `expo/plugins/withFmtXcode26Fix.js` — patches Podfile post_install to force C++17 for the fmt target + patches `base.h` to disable `FMT_USE_CONSTEVAL`
- `9fcb74ac` — plugin committed
- `58b19bdc` — app.config.ts updated to register the plugin

### iOS Workflow Rewrite (DONE ✅)

Replaced the manual `xcodebuild` approach (which failed 15+ times with flag issues) with `npx expo run:ios` — Expo's own CLI that handles prebuild + pods + xcodebuild + install + launch correctly.

### Android Emulator QA Workflow (NEW ✅)

Created `.github/workflows/android-emulator-qa.yml` — Ubuntu runner + Gradle APK build + Android emulator boot + Maestro launch test. **Android already proved the PNG fix works** by passing prebuild and building a valid APK.

  Latest run 30318829587 has both fixes. Building now. Cannot poll (rate limited for ~50 min).

```

## WHAT YOU NEED TO DO

**Check the GitHub Actions tab** at `https://github.com/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform/actions` in ~30-40 minutes. Look for:

1. **Run `30318829587` (iOS)** — If "Build and run on iOS Simulator" passes, the fmt fix worked and the app will install + launch on the simulator + Maestro will run. Screenshots will be in the artifacts.

2. **Run `30318829585` (Android)** — If "Boot Android Emulator" passes, the app installs and Maestro runs.

3. **If iOS still fails** — a new diagnostic GitHub issue (#6) will be auto-created with the actual build log. Paste it to me and I'll fix the next error.

**The key breakthrough:** I was never going to crack the iOS build by guessing xcodebuild flags. The diagnostic issue approach (auto-posting build logs as GitHub issues) finally gave me the real errors — corrupt PNGs first, then the fmt consteval issue. This includes creating special instructions for the computer to build and test the app automatically, fixing previous errors that prevented the tests from running, and ensuring everything is ready for the final checks.
